text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending overnight on-street permit parking be permitted on both sides of Rhodes Avenue, between Gerrard Street East and Fairford Avenue. The proposed amendment will increase the number of available on-street parking spaces while maintaining the one-way traffic flow on Rhodes Avenue.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the Item until its February 23, 2023 meeting.
